name: prometheis_benchmarks
description: Prometheis_benchmarks is a collection of tasks designed to evaluate language models on knowledge, reasoning, and instruction-following capabilities across diverse prompts. It aggregates multiple prompt-response formats to probe factual recall, multi-step reasoning, and robustness to instruction variations. The benchmark emphasizes comparative evaluation under standardized input templates to measure model generalization and hallucination tendencies.
reputation: Emerging community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in exploratory evaluations.
